data.title: 伊莉雅丝菲尔 · 旋转木马
data.description: 【伊莉雅 · 旋转木马】白天的游乐园里，伊莉雅坐在镀金白木马上，一手握住立柱稳住身体。看到台下为她拍照的同行者，她抬起另一手兴奋挥舞，银白长发随着木马转动轻轻扬起。
data.action: 坐在木马上，一手握立柱，另一手向台下摄影者挥手
data.promptProse: Riding the gilded white carousel horse, Illyasviel firmly holds its brass pole with one hand and waves toward the viewer with the other. Her cardigan and knee-length dress stay tidy in the stable seated pose, white hair moving behind the collar. The horizontal medium view includes horse and pole with painted panels and pennants beyond. Daylight glints on brass and gilding, while the canopy casts softer shade over her smile.
